key_results: Tool necessity linearly decodable from hidden states with AUROC 0.89-0.96; Probe&Prefill reduces unnecessary tool calls by 48% with only 1.7% accuracy loss vs. 6% reduction for best baseline
comments: Clever finding that models know tool necessity but fail to act on it; Probe&Prefill is practical but adds inference-time overhead.

model_io.model: LLM + linear probe on hidden states + prefill steering

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs possess latent knowledge of tool necessity in their hidden states independent of verbalized reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: hidden-state probes achieve AUROC 0.89-0.96, exceeding model's own reasoning quality

hypotheses.hypothesis: Steering via prefilled response based on hidden-state signal reduces unnecessary tool calls
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 48% tool call reduction with minimal accuracy loss vs. reasoning-based baselines

title: Hierarchical small molecule inhibition of MYST acetyltransferases
task: Systematic profiling of MYST lysine acetyltransferase inhibitor potency and selectivity
key_results: Chemoproteomic analysis reveals hierarchical inhibition: KAT6A/B >> KAT7 >> KAT8 >> KAT5 for PF-9363 and clinical candidate PF-8144; unexpected cross-inhibition of literature probes identified; dose-dependent target engagement at elevated concentrations
comments: Comprehensive profiling methodology establishes a framework for biomarker-driven KAT inhibitor characterization, though the clinical significance of dose-dependent off-target engagement at concentrations above therapeutic windows remains unclear.

model_io.model: Chemoproteomic profiling with histone acetylation biomarkers
inputs: drug-like MYST inhibitors (PF-9363, PF-8144, WM-8014, WM-1119, WM-3835)

hypotheses.hypothesis: MYST inhibitors exhibit kinase inhibitor-like dose-dependent target engagement with hierarchical selectivity
hypotheses.result: KAT6A/B >> KAT7 inhibition; off-target KAT8 engagement at elevated concentrations drives acute growth inhibition

title: Structural basis for prohibitin-mediated regulation of mitochondrial m-AAA protease
task: Elucidating prohibitin-mediated regulation of mitochondrial m-AAA protease
key_results: PHB complex cryo-EM structure: cage-like assembly of 11 PHB1/PHB2 heterodimers; m-AAA proteases enclosed via SIM-mediated interactions; disruption increases protease activity and decreases stress resistance
comments: The spatial organization model elegantly reconciles contradictory PHB/m-AAA phenotypes, but the molecular dynamics of substrate entry/exit and the stoichiometry of protease:PHB in native mitochondria warrant further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PHB complexes compartmentalize m-AAA proteases in membrane microdomains to fine-tune proteolytic homeostasis
hypotheses.result: Interface disruption elevates protease activity and diminishes stress resistance; assemblies visualized in situ

title: Transient tertiary structure in intrinsically disordered proteins revealed by multithermal enhanced sampling
task: Characterizing conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
key_results: OPES multithermal sampling reveals transient α-helical structures in ACTR that fold cooperatively; results consistent with REST2 and NMR/SAXS data while accelerating convergence

title: Large-scale discovery, analysis and design of protein energy landscapes
task: Large-scale mapping and design of protein conformational energy landscapes
key_results: HD-MS analysis of 5,778 protein domains (28–64 residues) reveals hidden variation in conformational fluctuations; site-resolved NMR of 13 domains shows secondary structural elements with lower stability than global fold; designed mutations stabilize low-stability segments
comments: The multiplexed experimental platform enables unprecedented scale in energy landscape profiling and provides machine-learning training data, but the generalizability of computationally-identified stabilizing mutations to diverse folds and the functional consequences of reduced fluctuations require broader validation.

hypotheses.result: Designed mutations successfully reduce fluctuations in test cases
